subject: general
question: A right circular cone is 6.7 cm high, and the radius of its base is 17.6 cm. It is melted and recast into a new right circular cone with a base radius of 8.8 cm. Find the height (in cm) of the new cone.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When an object is **recast**, its **volume remains constant**.

For a cone, Volume ∝ r²h.

⇒ r₁²h₁ = r₂²h₂

⇒ (17.6)² × 6.7 = (8.8)² × h₂

⇒ (2 × 8.8)² × 6.7 = (8.8)² × h₂ ⇒ 4 × 6.7 = h₂ = 26.8 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 26.8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Initial height (h₁) = 6.7 cm, Initial radius (r₁) = 17.6 cm, New radius (r₂) = 8.8 cm.

**Formula Used:** Volume of a **right circular cone** = (1/3) × π × r² × h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f93442e81a0200e34ada0c17cd65a57609a84361ce720056e827e53ee29b5a9e.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume of old cone = Volume of new cone

⇒ (1/3) × π × (r₁)² × h₁ = (1/3) × π × (r₂)² × h₂

⇒ (r₁)² × h₁ = (r₂)² × h₂

⇒ (17.6)² × 6.7 = (8.8)² × h₂

⇒ h₂ = (17.6 × 17.6 × 6.7) / (8.8 × 8.8)

⇒ h₂ = 2 × 2 × 6.7

⇒ h₂ = 4 × 6.7 = 26.8 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 26.8 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of Solids

When a solid is **melted and recast** into another shape, the **total volume** remains unchanged. This principle is used to find unknown dimensions.

Right Circular Cone Properties

Slant height (l) = √(r² + h²). Curved Surface Area (CSA) = πrl. Total Surface Area (TSA) = πr(l + r).

Ratio of Volumes

If the linear dimensions (radius or height) of similar cones are in ratio a:b, then their volumes are in ratio a³:b³.</p
